purpose: Reference topic taxonomy for backend/tests/fixtures/facet-quality/questions.ts, so the topic labels in that fixture are auditable rather than opaque.
methodology: Pass 1 (this file): gpt-5.2 was given the full cleaned, deduplicated, PII-scrubbed set of real visitor questions (question text only) and asked to propose 8-12 mutually distinguishable topics covering meaningful chunks of the traffic.

Pass 2 (questions.ts): gpt-5.2 was given each question in isolation, question text only, and asked to assign exactly one topic slug from this taxonomy or null, plus a detected language and a short language-neutral intent slug used to find genuine cross-lingual paraphrase groups. The labeller never saw a facet, so labels are not biased toward the facet representation the eval scores against.

A first taxonomy draft (10 topics) was checked against the labelled set for recurring themes left as outliers; an 8-item real cluster about flower-essence/aura sprays was found under-represented, so 'wellness_products_sprays' was added and the labelling pass was rerun against the corrected 11-topic taxonomy.

topics.label: Retreats/courses schedule & booking
topics.description: Requests for upcoming retreats/courses/events, specific date ranges, daily programmes, what's on at a center, and how to join/register or plan a visit/weekend stay.

topics.label: Kriya Yoga path & initiation
topics.description: Questions about what Kriya Yoga is, how to prepare, requirements/steps, initiation formats (online vs residential), Kriyaban retreats, access to Kriyaban sections, and improving one's Kriya practice.

topics.label: Meditation guidance & live meditations
topics.description: Requests for guided meditations, help with meditation practice, which meditation offerings exist today, and participation in live/streamed meditations or ceremonies.

topics.label: Yoga practice content (asanas, routines, videos)
topics.description: Finding or requesting yoga/asana instructions, short routines, Salutation to the Sun videos, free practice material, and navigation issues specific to yoga content pages.

topics.label: Locations, local groups & sangha connections
topics.description: Finding Ananda centers/groups by geography (cities/countries), UK/Portugal listings, local contacts, and how to connect with a nearby sangha/meditation group.

topics.label: Volunteering (seva) & working at Ananda
topics.description: How to do seva/volunteer, how service is structured, proposals for service projects, and practical questions about working roles (e.g., cook) at Ananda.

topics.label: Pilgrimages/travel & on-site logistics (esp. Assisi/India)
topics.description: Questions about organized trips/pilgrimages (notably India/Assisi), dates for pilgrimages, how to get there by car, and practical visit planning while in the area.

topics.label: Online courses platform, access & payments
topics.description: Buying online courses, login/credentials issues, where to find "My courses", course availability/expiry, technical support requests, and payment-by-instalments questions.

topics.label: Media, social channels, newsletters & site navigation
topics.description: Requests for YouTube/social profiles, what content is on channels, newsletters and what they announce, blog lists/latest posts, and 'what is this page about'/site-content navigation help.

topics.label: Teachings & spiritual philosophy
topics.description: Questions about Self-realization, ego vs Self, karma, grace/faith, Raja Yoga, why yoga, and interpretation of Ananda/Yogananda/Kriyananda teachings beyond scheduling or logistics.

topics.label: Teachers/lineage info & controversies
topics.description: Who key figures are (Yogananda, Swami Kriyananda, Asha, Jayadev, etc.), their roles/books/tours, and reputation/controversy questions (e.g., lawsuits, misconduct allegations). Every name in the fixture referring to this topic is a public figure or the organization's own teacher/author, never a private visitor.

topics.label: Wellness products (flower-essence sprays etc.)
topics.description: Questions about buying or choosing flower-essence/aura sprays and similar wellness products the organization sells, what they are, and which ones exist in the product line.
